name: 34983 · Port St Lucie, FL
findings: ZIP 34983 (Port St Lucie) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 34 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34983 (Port St Lucie) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 1 social and fraternal organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.
